text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to interview for appointment to the Toronto Transit Commission. Following the interviews, the Civic Appointments Committee will recommend two public members for appointment to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Toronto Transit Commission: TTC2-43 TTC2-66 TTC2-190 TTC2-250 TTC2-266 TTC2-271 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (November 27, 2020) from the Interim City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Transit Commission.
